messages:
pagerbot: PAGER: High GPU attach-deny rate in asia-southeast2. Autoscaler failing to provision new replicas; queue depth for inference-pool-apse1 increased from 20 -> 400 in 8m. Error sample: `ZONE_RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED` from GCP. Paging on-call.

sam: acked. looking now. -- pulling autoscaler logs and quota metrics.

maya: seeing repeated attach deny: `Quota exceeded for resource 'accelerator'` on node attach attempts. Confirming GCP project quotas show 0 available gpus in ap-southeast2.

alex: tagging infra: @ria any quick wins to free capacity or reroute?

ria: @alex @sam running preflight. options: 1) failover traffic to ap-southeast1 pool (lower latency for some tenants) 2) request emergency quota bump from GCP (slow) 3) shrink model replicas temporarily to free GPUs (risk of higher latency for queued requests).

sam: customer impact: several customers report 5-30s extra latency, a small subset getting 503s on chat endpoints when queue > 300. Ramping error budget usage. Starting mitigation plan.

infra-bot: Runbook step 1 completed: identified offending job label `inference-burst` causing warmup churn. Step 2 in progress: scaling policy audit.

maya: quick mitigation: disable burst scaling on ap-southeast2 (set max_replicas to current), and switch routing rule to prefer ap-southeast1 for non-APAC traffic. Applying now: `redwoodctl region set-weight --from=apore1 --to=apse2 --weight=0.2` (will lower new requests to apse2).

sam: applied. Confirmed autoscaler not attempting new attaches — attach-deny rate reduced, but queue still draining slowly. Need to create ticket with GCP for quota - submitting with support level escalation. Case: 1234567890 (created).

alex: can we spin up dedicated fallback pool in us-central1 and failover heavy batch jobs there? Some customers are routed by region pinning though.

ria: yes for unpinned tenants. Spinning up dedicated-fallback-usc now. Estimated time ~6m to be healthy.

ops-lead: note for timeline and comms: prepare update to SRE on-call and support ops. ETA estimate: partial mitigation now, full recovery depends on either quota grant or capacity shift.

sam: logs dump (snippet):
```
2026-03-17T14:01:02Z autoscaler[attach]: attempt attach node-xxx -> ZONE_RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED: accelerator limit reached
2026-03-17T14:01:02Z scheduler: enqueue request id=abcd1234 queue_depth=312
2026-03-17T14:03:40Z autoscaler[attach]: backoff 30s
```

maya: note: other regions show spare GPUs but cross-region latency penalty; we'll route async/low-priority jobs there first. Real-time chat traffic for pinned APAC customers will remain impacted until quota or node attach succeeds.

ria: GCP support responded: they can approve temporary quota increase if we provide justification and expected peak. Requested ETA 45-90m. Meanwhile suggest reclaiming unused GPUs from low-priority pools: running reclamation job now.

sam: reclaim job killed 12 idle nodes, reclaimed 24 GPUs; autoscaler retried attaches -> a few succeeded. queue depth dropped from 312 -> 180 in 6m. Progressing.

alex: good. start drafting customer-facing blurb for support: short note about degraded performance in APAC region and recommended workaround (switch to multi-region routing).

ops-lead: we should also enable fallback model variant (smaller quantized) for pinned customers to reduce GPU footprint — opt-in via feature flag for impacted tenants. Ria, can platform push the flag?

ria: pushing feature flag now: `feature-fallback-quantized=on` for tenants with tag apac-pin. Pushed; will be active within 1m.

sam: after flag + reclamation + routing adjustments queue at 90 and 503s dropped to near zero. Continuing to monitor.

pagerbot: INCIDENT NOTE: mitigation in progress. severity P1 -> P2 if no customer-visible errors in next 30m.

maya: followup actions: 1) keep GCP case open and update with reclaimed capacity numbers 2) review autoscaler attach/backoff settings to avoid wide churn 3) run postmortem on burst policy config 4) add quota alert when available GPUs <= 10% of max.

ria: saving logs and snapshots to incident folder: `s3://redwood-incidents/6632104000/`

sam: handing to next on-call @maya for monitoring window; I'll stay on standby for comms.

maya: ack — taking handoff. posting status update to #support and tagging affected account leads. :thumbsup:

ops-lead: updating incident board and scheduling postmortem with infra and autoscaler owners tomorrow 9:00 UTC.

pagerbot: INCIDENT CLOSED? monitoring window passed 35m with stable queues and zero new attach-deny errors. Please confirm before final close.

sam: closing after final check at +60m. good job team. :party_parrot:
